row: Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine

Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine is accredited by the American Veterinary Medical Association Council on Education (AVMA-COE). Since its founding in 1982, RUSVM has graduated nearly 8,000 veterinarians, many practicing in every U.S. state, in Canada and Puerto Rico, and abroad.

At Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine, our students learn adaptability, resilience, and patience fostered by island life and a rigorous academic program.
